entities.summary: Dina Cocea was a Romanian stage actress and occasional movie star with a career that spanned 70 years. Among other activities, Cocea was an actor in residence at the National Theatre Bucharest for 17 years, a professor and Dean at the University of Bucharest, writer and columnist, playwright, political activist, and representative to UNESCO.
